hook_line: UK NET MIGRATION FALLS TO LOWEST SINCE 1997

diaspora_bullets: Indians remain the most common non-EU nationality arriving in the UK, with study the most common reason
Work arrivals fell 25% in a year — the door is narrower, not closed
news_summary: Provisional ONS figures show UK net migration fell to 77,000 in the year ending June 2026, down from 204,000 a year earlier — the lowest since 1997 outside the pandemic.
payoff: Indians are still the largest non-EU group coming to Britain, but work arrivals fell 25% in a year.
